I prefer team sports over individual sports because it promotes cooperation and teaches me to appreciate the value of every teammate's abilities and how cooperation can contribute to a shared goal.
C: Some people say that school sports make children too competitive. What do you think about this
issue?
I disagree with this opinion because team sports make you a more supportive and patient person on and off the field. To explain, team sports teach people how to work with and help others instead of being a competitive person.
Part 3 :
Question 1 : What do you usually do to stay in shape?
To stay in shape ,I often run in the early morning. I get up at about 4.30 and start  running with my neighbors. This makes me healthy and gives me active energy for a working day.
Question 2 : I often get up early to run in the morning because I am too tired in the evening, and you?
Firstly, after a long sleeping night I often feel tired, therefore running helps me relaxed. Secondly, I think that running is a type of sport which is good for our health. It helps me stay in shape and gives me a lot of energy.
(Thirdly, running is also a treatment for stress and diseases.)
Question 3 : Now that technology has developed, people are attracted to it and lazy to exercise, what do you think about this issue?
I completely agree that people are too lazy to exercise due to  the development of technology. There are a lot of interesting things on the internet that they are attracted to. Moreover , modern machines help humans with housework and factory work. People depend on them  too much .

The bad experience I had with technology was when I was preparing for a group project, then the screen blacked out. I could not express my feelings at that time but everything was terrible. All my documents disappeared and I had to start over again.
Q2: I watch movies online on my laptop and I hardly ever go to the cinema. Where would you rather watch and why?
I prefer going to the cinema with friends to watching online movies at home because we have a good time together and after that, we can share with each other if we enjoyed it or not. It is an interesting experience to watch in a spacious place.
Q3: Improvements in technology make our lives better. What do you think?
I totally agree with you because we are living in the era/ time of technology. Everything is much easier, more convenient with the help from technology, particularly changing the way we access resources, learn new things, widen relationships and so on.

I love the quiet space when watching movies, so I often watch film on TV at home. When watching movies, I enjoy eating popcorns and drinking pep-si to make my watching experience more interesting.
B: Do you like watching TV alone or with other people? Why?
Some people like watching TV with their family and friends but I prefer watching TV alone. To clarify, I want to focus on the content of the movie or the program I'm watching and other people can distract me from my favorite program.

I agree with this idea. To clarify, spending a long time sitting glued to the screen can cause eyestrain or short-sighted for children. Besides, they can be addicted to watching TV and neglect their studying if watching too much.
